subject: EMEA mid-quarter pipeline sweep & commit confirmations
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance EMEA <finance-emea@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:05:00 +0100
Subject: EMEA mid-quarter pipeline sweep & commit confirmations

Team —

Quick reminder as we hit the middle of the quarter: finance is doing a short commit review tomorrow for EMEA and we need clean stages/commit indicators in HubSpot by EOD today. Please do the following before 18:00 BST:

- Update stage for all open opportunities where there has been a discovery/demo in the last 30 days.
- Mark "Commit" only if legal + procurement responses are received and you have an internal forecast date.
- Add a short note in the deal timeline for any late-stage risk (pricing, procurement, PoC).

I've attached a one-row export template to make the rollup easier (EMEA_forecast_template.xlsx) and a shared sheet to capture final commit USD by country: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2bEMEAforecast/edit#gid=0

We'll run a 30-min commit review (EMEA) tomorrow 09:30 BST — invite will go out after I pull the final numbers. If you have stalls, @reply with a 1-line reason.

Thanks — short and sharp.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of EMEA Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: EMEA_forecast_template.xlsx (Excel)

Subject: Re: EMEA mid-quarter pipeline sweep & commit confirmations

Done — I updated all EMEA North accounts I own.

Notes:
- ACME Nordics (EM-4521) remains late-stage but procurement requested updated SOW; I left a note in the timeline and flagged as "At Risk" rather than Commit.
- Two mid-sized renewals converted to Commit; numbers reflected in the shared sheet.

I've updated HubSpot and added line items for the two large opportunities:
- NordicCloud strategic (EM-4521): procurement has asked for revised payment milestones; legal review in progress. Not a hard commit — marked "Commit - Contingent" in the sheet.
- AlpineData (EM-4608): sales-led POC completed, procurement verbally committed; finance asked for confirmed billing start date to mark as Commit.

I've exported the interim commit numbers to Q2_commit_sheet.csv and uploaded to the shared folder. Finance — can you confirm whether verbal procurement commitment is sufficient for Q2 recognition, or do we need signed PO?

Cc: NordicCloud Procurement <procurement@nordiccloud.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EMEA mid-quarter pipeline sweep & commit confirmations

Hi all —

Procurement (NordicCloud) here. Quick clarification on EM-4521: we received a proposed SOW yesterday; our legal team needs one small change to the data residency clause before we can issue a PO. We expect to return the redline today.

If you can provide a version with the clause options (EU-only / multi-region) that will speed things up. Can the team upload that to the shared Drive or drop it here?

Regards,
Jules Martin
Procurement Lead (Nordics)
NordicCloud

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Finance EMEA <finance-emea@redwood.com>
Cc: Jules Martin <jules@eu-consulting.io>, NordicCloud Procurement <procurement@nordiccloud.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 17:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: EMEA mid-quarter pipeline sweep & commit confirmations — rollup

Thanks for the fast updates. Final rollup below (numbers USD):
- Committed: 1,150,000 (confirmed signed PO or procurement email + billing start date)
- Commit - Contingent: 420,000 (pending SOW redline / PO)
- At Risk: 310,000 (pricing / timeline concerns)

I've attached the consolidated CSV (Q2_commit_sheet.csv) and uploaded the updated SOW with both data-residency options for EM-4521 to the Drive. Finance: please confirm whether "procurement email + billing start date" is sufficient for recognition — if not, we should plan for a short sales-led push tomorrow AM to secure signatures.

Next steps:
- 09:30 BST tomorrow — 30-min commit review (invite sent).
- Sales leads to highlight any deals that require a final legal/procurement action (1-line).
- Finance to advise recognition rules for contingent items.

Thanks — great responsiveness today.

Hannah
Head of EMEA Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_commit_sheet.csv (CSV), EM-4521_SOW_options.docx (Doc)
